description: Defines a template class 'pucch_format1_map' that maps elements of type T to PUCCH Format 1 initial cyclic shifts and time domain OCC indices, including iterators, insertion, access, and utility functions.

classes.name: pucch_format1_map
classes.description: Template class mapping elements of type T to PUCCH Format 1 cyclic shifts and OCC indices, with nested const_iterator class.

classes.name: pucch_format1_map::const_iterator
classes.description: Read-only iterator traversing active entries of the map, providing access to initial cyclic shift, OCC, and value.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an element exists at given cyclic shift and OCC indices.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs a new element in-place at specified coordinates.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new element with a specified value at given coordinates.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Accesses a modifiable or constant reference to the element at specified coordinates.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all contents of the map.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of active elements.
